subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to discover and claim ClawHub promotional model offers

question: Should ClawHub promotional model activation land as a new core `openclaw promos` command group via https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100236, or be folded into an existing models/configure/plugin surface?
rationale: The request adds a new core CLI surface that consumes remote ClawHub data and updates provider auth/model configuration; VISION.md supports CLI/provider ergonomics but also keeps optional capability out of core unless the core boundary is justified.

options.title: Review Linked Core PR
options.body: Treat the dedicated `openclaw promos` command group as the intended direction and review the linked PR for API readiness, auth/config safety, docs, and proof.

options.title: Fold Into Existing Models Flow
options.body: Ask the implementation to expose promotions through `openclaw models` or `configure` instead of adding a new root command group.

options.title: Defer Core Surface
options.body: Keep this open until the ClawHub producer endpoint is live and maintainers confirm a core CLI path is needed beyond plugin or ClawHub-owned flows.

recommendation.title: Review Linked Core PR
recommendation.body: Treat the dedicated `openclaw promos` command group as the intended direction and review the linked PR for API readiness, auth/config safety, docs, and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They own both the feature request and the linked OpenClaw/ClawHub implementation work, so they are best positioned to answer the surface and sequencing question for maintainer review.
